extension.summary: Track and watch your Trakt next episodes via Real-Debrid.
extension.description: Episode Tracker focuses on one job: your Trakt "next up" episodes. It pulls the next unwatched episode for every show you are progressing through on Trakt.tv, scrapes torrent sources with the CocoScrapers module, resolves cached links through Real-Debrid, plays them, and scrobbles your progress back to Trakt. Requires the script.module.cocoscrapers module, a Trakt.tv account, and a Real-Debrid subscription.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host, provide, or link to any content. It is a metadata and playback front-end for services the user independently subscribes to (Trakt.tv and Real-Debrid) and third-party scraper modules the user independently installs. The author is not responsible for the content accessed through it, and is in no way affiliated with Kodi, Team Kodi, or the XBMC Foundation.
extension.news: v1.0.2 - Fixes the cache silently failing when the addon profile directory is missing, which could stop update notices appearing.

extension.summary: Install and update Episode Tracker from within Kodi.
extension.description: Repository for the Episode Tracker add-on. Once installed, Kodi can install and update Episode Tracker natively through Add-ons - Install from repository.
